programme.title: The Great Food Guys
programme.desc: Nick Nairn and Dougie Vipond focus on meat and cook a rack of Scotch lamb with roast miso aubergine and sauce vierge. Joining them in the kitchen are shepherdess Michelle Stephen from Aberdeenshire and comedian farmer Jim Smith, who selects a local Perthshire beer to accompany the food.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are one year into building their own farm, taking on a tenancy at Dunrod Farm and a big bank loan with the dream of one day owning 5,000 sheep. But a trip to market sees higher prices scupper their best intentions.

programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: Former gamekeeper David Campbell takes the stand to defend himself against a murder charge built on circumstantial evidence. Will the jury believe him?

programme.title: David Wilson's Crime Files
programme.desc: David and guests delve into the psychology of criminals who lead a secret or double life, hiding behind a front in order to cover up their illegal activities, and how the idea of the 'dual nature and duality' is imbedded in the Scottish psyche.

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Martin Geissler asks what job cuts at the Ferguson shipyard tell us about our ferry problems.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: A portrait of legendary former Scotland captain Gary McAllister, a classy midfielder who suffered heartbreaking lows as well as highs that stand as a testament to his enduring class.

programme.title: Scotland's Home of the Year
programme.desc: The judges have invited the six regional winners to join them at Glasgow's House for an Art Lover. Here, they will go through the homes one by one, assessing them on architectural merit, distinctive design and personal style.

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: It's the grand final, featuring the seven category winners chosen by friends and family from all over Scotland. The seven finalists are: Argyll Cruising, Arcadia Glamping Cabins, Inverlonan Bothies, Kilmartin Castle, Glen Dye Cabins and Cottages and Loch Ken Eco Bothies. Now they need to impress the expert judges over three stages to win the crown.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Lynn Cameron has transformed the shared waste pile behind her house into a sustainable garden made entirely from recycled items and seeds from seed share programmes. Lynn has created a folly built entirely from discarded stones and bricks, a pond from old tyres, and a large seat from old decking boards. She even rescued an old stained-glass window to incorporate into her folly.

programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: It's the Isle of Kerrera's annual triathlon, an event that attracts competitors and spectators to the island. Despite its proximity to the mainland, providing supplies and the infrastructure for such a big event is no mean feat for the MV Carvori.

programme.title: River City
programme.desc: A giddy Angus plans to surprise Amber, but his ploy accidentally causes a misunderstanding. Mulvaney is forced to help Harry carry out his escape plan, a kind gesture from Conor goes a long way, and Callum is left reeling after confronting Shak.

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: A portrait of Julie Fleeting, who became Scotland's all-time top scorer and an Arsenal legend while balancing life as a mum and PE teacher.

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Conversation about Scotland's biggest news stories, hosted by Martin Geissler.

programme.title: The Trials That Shocked Scotland
programme.desc: In 2004, Luke Mitchell stood trial for the murder of his teenage girlfriend Jodi Jones, who was killed the previous year in Dalkeith, Midlothian. Her death sent shockwaves throughout the community and across Scotland. Four years later, the trial began of the man accused of murdering Shamsuddin Mahmood, 14 years after his death. British Army soldier Michael Ross was accused of shooting and killing the Bangladeshi national. It was the first murder on the island in a quarter of a century.
